turns.reply:
Here is an overview of your account status:

- **Account issues:** None.
- **Disapprovals:** 13 products are disapproved. The main causes are price mismatches (3 products), invalid image links (3 products), titles being too long (2 products), availability mismatches (2 products), missing shipping information (2 products), and restricted product policies (1 product).
- **Warnings:** 6 products have warnings (demoted) for missing GTINs (product barcode numbers).

Let's address the largest disapproval issue first: **Price Mismatches** (3 products).

The price listed in your product feed must match the price on your product page and at checkout ([Price in the feed does not match the website](https://support.google.com/merchants/answer/12159029)). The affected products are:

1. **HG-004 "Waffle Weave Bath Towel, Sage"**: Feed shows 32.00 USD, but the product page shows 36.00 USD.
2. **HG-015 "Pour Over Coffee Set, Glass and Copper"**: Feed shows 58.00 USD, but the product page shows 64.00 USD.
3. **HG-021 "Stainless Steel Kettle, 1.7 L"**: Feed shows 48.00 USD, but the product page shows 44.00 USD.

**How to fix:**
Update the price in your product feed so it matches the website exactly, then re-upload your data. Google's crawler will recheck the pages within a few hours or days ([Price in the feed does not match the website](https://support.google.com/merchants/answer/12159029)).

Additionally, your automatic price updates setting is currently turned off. Turning on automatic item updates for price under Products > Automations can help update small price mismatches automatically using structured data on your website ([Automatic item updates for price and availability](https://support.google.com/merchants/answer/3246284)).
